metadata.description: Autonomous development workflow toolkit distributed as one self-contained plugin. Installing build clones the whole repository once, so every skill, agent, and workflow loads under the build: namespace with no cross-plugin duplication.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: End-to-end development from an agreed Issue. Settle the requirements into an Issue with /scoping (optionally after /challenge), then hand the Issue to /implement, which carries it through the implement workflow to implementation, verification, a draft PR, and CI confirmation. Heavy assurance (/audit, /polish) is human-invoked on that draft PR. Bundles the full reviewer and critic agent set, the implement / audit / polish / shake / assert / adrift workflows, and /sweep, /outcome, /dr, /census, /scribe.
